title: Iowa Business Registry Active Entities
description: Governed Iowa Secretary of State active-entity layer using business identity and source-defined home-office fields only, with ZIP/ZCTA context, source geocodes, provenance, and explicit non-site semantics.
coverage_claim: Entities listed as active in the official monthly Iowa Secretary of State dataset; this is source-specific active-registration evidence, not a census of every operating business or physical site.
identity_rule: Each unique six-digit Iowa corporation number becomes one provisional organization candidate. Home-office addresses and source geocodes remain registration assertions and never create physical sites or establishments.
